description: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time (2007 Chunsoft, Nintendo DS, via RetroArch / melonDS)
long: The original half of the Explorers duology, released alongside Explorers of Darkness. You wake up as a human turned Pokemon with no memory, take on a partner, join Wigglytuff's Guild and descend into procedurally generated mystery dungeons where every step you take is a turn the whole floor takes with you. The story is the series' most-loved and unusually sombre one. Time and Darkness are the same adventure with different exclusives: each version has its own recruitable Pokemon and a handful of version-only dungeons, and the two carts can trade rescues. The 2009 re-release Explorers of Sky is the expanded cut of the same game.
name: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time
short: Turn-based roguelike in which you wake up as a Pokemon: recruit a team, delve procedurally generated dungeons and follow the series' most-loved story. Paired release with Explorers of Darkness.
